2023-04-26
Claim opened after the policyholder reported being struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant is the
driver of the other vehicle and is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's
office.
2023-05-19
Reviewed the initial statements from both drivers and the police report. Both accounts describe the same sequence of
events, with the other vehicle entering the intersection as the policyholder completed the left turn.
2023-05-20
Obtained scene photographs and spoke with two independent witnesses, who both confirm the collision occurred as
described. Nothing in their accounts conflicts with the other driver's version.
2023-06-01
Inspected the vehicle damage. The damage is mostly consistent with the impact descriebd and lines up with the
points of contact shown in the scene photos.
2023-06-08
Verified coverage. The driving policyholder lives with the named insured and qualifies as a covered houeshold
member. Nothing suggests the damage predates the start of the policy.
2023-06-12
Requested prior claims history for the vehicle and found no earlier damage on record that would overlap with this
loss.
2023-06-24
Received the claimant's medical records through counsel. The reported knee injury fits well with the type and force of
a side impact of this kind.
2023-07-26
Reviewed the treatment history. The care followed a typical course, with frequency of visits tapering as the claimant
improved and returned to normal activity.
2023-08-13
Checked prior medical records for the same body area and found no earlier injury or complaint involving the knee.
2023-09-09
Spoke with the claimant through counsel. The account given matches what was described in every earlier
conversation, with no material differences in the details.
2023-10-19
Noted that the exact seating position of the claimant at impact is not fully clear from the available records. This is
being documented, though it does not crurently change the assessment of the injury.
2023-11-01
Current status: liability and injury evaluation are substantially complete. File is pending final review and settlement
discussions with counsel.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
